indexes.unused_indexes: SELECT s.schemaname AS database_name, s.relname AS table_name, s.indexrelname AS index_name, pg_size_pretty(pg_relation_size(s.indexrelid)) AS index_size FROM pg_stat_user_indexes s WHERE s.idx_scan = 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_index i WHERE i.indexrelid = s.indexrelid AND (i.indisprimary OR i.indisunique)) AND s.schemaname NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema') ORDER BY pg_relation_size(s.indexrelid) DESC LIMIT 10;
indexes.redundant_indexes: SELECT a.schemaname AS database_name, a.tablename AS table_name, a.indexname AS redundant_index_name, a.indexdef AS redundant_index_columns, b.indexname AS dominant_index_name, b.indexdef AS dominant_index_columns FROM pg_indexes a JOIN pg_indexes b ON a.tablename = b.tablename AND a.indexname <> b.indexname AND a.schemaname = b.schemaname WHERE position(replace(a.indexdef, a.indexname, '') IN replace(b.indexdef, b.indexname, '')) > 0 AND a.schemaname NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema') ORDER BY a.tablename LIMIT 10;
indexes.queries_high_full_table_scans: SELECT relname AS table_name, seq_scan AS full_table_scans, seq_tup_read AS rows_read_via_scan, idx_scan AS index_scans, CASE WHEN (seq_scan + idx_scan) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((seq_scan::numeric / (seq_scan + idx_scan)) * 100, 2) END AS scan_ratio_pct FROM pg_stat_user_tables WHERE seq_scan > 0 ORDER BY full_table_scans DESC LIMIT 10;
indexes.low_selectivity_indexes: SELECT database_name, table_name, column_name, n_distinct, correlation, estimated_selectivity_pct FROM (SELECT s.schemaname AS database_name, s.tablename AS table_name, s.attname AS column_name, s.n_distinct, s.correlation, CASE WHEN s.n_distinct > 0 THEN ROUND(((s.n_distinct / GREATEST(c.reltuples, 1)) * 100)::numeric, 2) WHEN s.n_distinct < 0 THEN ROUND((ABS(s.n_distinct) * 100)::numeric, 2) ELSE 0 END AS estimated_selectivity_pct FROM pg_stats s JOIN pg_class c ON c.relname = s.tablename JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace AND n.nspname = s.schemaname WHERE s.schemaname NOT IN ('pg_catalog', 'information_schema') AND c.reltuples > 1000 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_indexes i WHERE i.tablename = s.tablename AND i.schemaname = s.schemaname AND position(s.attname IN i.indexdef) > 0)) sub WHERE estimated_selectivity_pct < 5 ORDER BY estimated_selectivity_pct ASC LIMIT 10;

users.account_password_hygiene: SELECT r.rolname AS username, r.rolcanlogin AS can_login, r.rolsuper AS is_superuser, r.rolinherit AS inherits_privileges, r.rolcreatedb AS can_create_db, r.rolcreaterole AS can_create_roles, r.rolvaliduntil AS password_expires_at, CASE WHEN r.rolvaliduntil IS NULL THEN 'NEVER EXPIRES' WHEN r.rolvaliduntil < NOW() THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE 'POLICY ENFORCED' END AS password_risk_status FROM pg_roles r WHERE r.rolname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND r.rolcanlogin = true ORDER BY password_risk_status DESC LIMIT 10;
users.excessive_administrative_privileges: SELECT grantee, table_catalog AS database_name, privilege_type, is_grantable FROM information_schema.role_table_grants WHERE privilege_type IN ('DELETE', 'TRUNCATE', 'REFERENCES', 'TRIGGER') AND grantee NOT IN ('postgres') ORDER BY grantee LIMIT 10;
